title: Monk Mode Will Change Your Life In 90 Days
hook: If you want to become unrecognizable in six months, you must disappear for ninety days.

scenes.text: If you want to become unrecognizable in six months, you must disappear for ninety days.
scenes.visual_prompt: solitary silhouette of a man meditating on foggy mountain peak at dawn, golden sunrise rim light

scenes.text: Cut out cheap dopamine, toxic friendships, and endless mindless scrolling.
scenes.visual_prompt: shattered glowing smartphone screen lying on dark cold stone pavement, sparks and smoke

scenes.text: When you isolate yourself to master one high-income skill and train your body daily, magic happens.
scenes.visual_prompt: intense scholar writing notes in ancient candlelit library surrounded by towering bookshelves

scenes.text: People will wonder where you went, but you will re-emerge with unshakeable confidence and focus.
scenes.visual_prompt: sharp dressed confident man walking out of shadowy dark corridor into bright modern daylight

scenes.text: Are you willing to sacrifice short-term comfort for lifelong freedom? Comment YES if you are locked in.
